verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an AI video platform, since vendors can offer on-prem or private deployments, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes HeyGen's hosted cloud service: REST/CLI/MCP access, dedicated GPUs run by HeyGen, and zero-data-retention options. These are adjacent enterprise controls, not a self-hostable core product, and nothing documents an on-prem or self-hosted deployment.
